localityLead.tableMeaning: The 2025 article Table 1 labels this column year of introduction. It is not a collection/survey date and does not establish present-day occurrence.
localityLead.provenance: A secondary 2025 table row citing Chavez and Carandang (2014); the underlying proceedings and site-level evidence were not available for direct review.

limits: The DLSU repository confirms a 2014 conference proceeding and its abstract but marks the uploaded full text unavailable.
The indexed 2025 Table 1 row is a secondary retelling; the article concerns a 2023 Lake Naujan survey, not a 2025 Angat River survey.
The proceedings abstract describes Pterygoplichthys spp. at eight Luzon sites; no site-level Angat table, voucher, specimen image, precise coordinates, or separate identification method was reviewed.
Year of introduction 2005 must not be substituted for observation date or current presence.
No article-specific data-reuse permission was verified for either source; the table was not transcribed into Bangwit application data.

rights.disposition: Rights are unresolved; preserve citations and research-only metadata, and do not republish source table content.

nextStep: Seek the original 2014 proceedings site table or an independent, rights-cleared specimen-backed Angat River record. Keep Angat separate from the Bustos study reach and do not publish this introduction-year lead as a current record.
